extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism/delivery adjudication; no unsupported direct molecular killing mechanism is promoted.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: E. coli surface-displayed Lpp-OmpA-multimeric Buf IIIb-L fusion proteins
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper supports a delivery/activation mechanism in which Buf IIIb-L tandem multimers are displayed on the E. coli surface and converted by pepsin into active monomers.
mechanism_claims.limitations: This is a delivery/activation mechanism, not a direct molecular target claim for Buf IIIb-L killing.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: synthetic Buf IIIb-L after enzyme digestion
mechanism_claims.claim_text: File S1 supports protease-dependent activity: pepsin-digested Buf IIIb-L retains MIC activity, while trypsin- and chymotrypsin-digested material is inactive at the tested upper range.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The supplement supports processing/activity retention, not a separate membrane-target quantification.

mechanism_claims.entity_scope: Buf IIIb derivatives as antimicrobial peptides
mechanism_claims.claim_text: The article uses background AMP/cell-penetrating peptide rationale but does not provide a direct molecular killing-mechanism assay for membrane disruption or nucleic-acid binding in this paper.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not normalize this background into direct_mechanism evidence.
